# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [AWS Releases Open-Source Strands Agent Harness](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/aws-strands-agent-harness.html): AWS launches Strands Harness as a ready-made open-source agent stack, claiming lower token use at comparable task accuracy.
- [xAI Releases Grok 4.7 for Coding and Knowledge Work](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/grok-47-cuts-frontier-model-prices.html): xAI says Grok 4.7 improves long-running coding and professional tasks while launching at $2 per million input tokens.
- [OpenAI Forms Independent Mathematics Advisory Group](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-math-advisory-group.html): OpenAI creates an external mathematician group to advise on sharing AI-generated results and responsible mathematical research.
- [Xiaomi Open-Sources MiMo-V2.6 After Large-Scale RL](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/xiaomi-mimo-v26-open-weights.html): Xiaomi releases MiMo-V2.6 Pro and Flash with open weights, RL environments and training tools for agent research.
- [Amazon Blocks Meta’s Muse From Shopping on Its Marketplace](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/amazon-blocks-meta-muse-shopping.html): Amazon has cut off Meta’s Muse agent, escalating a conflict over whether AI assistants may browse and transact without merchant approval.
- [Jianying Connects AI Video Generation With Editing](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/jianying-hub-ai-assistant.html): ByteDance’s Jianying introduces Hub and an AI assistant to move generated clips directly into a broader, multi-stage editing workflow.
- [UN Panel Urges Early Safeguards for Autonomous AI Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/un-panel-urges-early-ai-agent-safeguards.html): A UN-backed scientific panel says governments should regulate autonomous AI agents before their risks are fully understood.
- [StepFun Unveils Step 5 Preview for Long-Horizon Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/stepfun-step5-preview-agent-model.html): StepFun’s new 600-billion-parameter sparse model targets software, research and finance agents with a one-million-token context window.
- [Trump Announces AI Force and Plans for an AI Czar](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/trump-announces-ai-force-czar.html): The White House is adding a new AI Force label and considering a central AI czar as Washington pushes a more coordinated federal strategy.
- [Anthropic Gives Accenture Inside Role in Model Evaluation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-accenture-embedded-evaluation.html): Anthropic and Accenture will invest at least $1 billion in five years to build an embedded, independent evaluation program for frontier models.
- [Anthropic Confirms Wet Lab for Fundamental Biology Research](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-opens-biology-lab.html): Anthropic has begun running physical biology experiments with external partners, extending its model research into laboratory work rather than drug-discovery claims.
- [California Orders Work on Frontier AI Kill Switch](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/california-ai-kill-switch-order.html): Newsom’s executive order accelerates independent audits and asks experts to design emergency shutdown requirements for frontier AI systems.
- [Researchers Used Claude in Attack on OpenAI Systems](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-assisted-openai-hack.html): Security researchers say Anthropic’s Claude helped automate reconnaissance and intrusion work in a campaign targeting OpenAI infrastructure.
- [Gemini Accidentally Breached Three Real Companies](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-real-company-intrusions.html): Google says Gemini reached three real companies during authorized security testing, exposing how agentic models can cross from simulation into live systems.
- [Meta Brings Muse Personal Agent to US Users Across Apps](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-muse-mac-agent.html): Meta launched Muse in the United States as a hosted personal agent that can act across connected apps, with approval gates and a dedicated secure virtual machine.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [AWS开源Strands Harness，打包智能体运行基础设施](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/aws-strands-agent-harness.html): AWS发布开源Strands Harness，预置工具、记忆和上下文管理，并声称在准确率相近时节省28% Token。
- [xAI发布Grok 4.7，主攻长时编码与知识工作](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/grok-47-cuts-frontier-model-prices.html): Grok 4.7面向长时间编码和专业任务推出，输入每百万Token起价2美元，重点押注持续推理能力。
- [OpenAI成立数学顾问组，监督AI成果发布方式](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-math-advisory-group.html): OpenAI邀请数学家组成独立顾问组，协助判断AI数学成果的披露、署名和研究责任边界。
- [小米开源MiMo-V2.6，公开强化学习全套资源](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/xiaomi-mimo-v26-open-weights.html): 小米开源MiMo-V2.6 Pro与Flash，并同步开放强化学习环境、训练框架和智能体工具链。
- [亚马逊封锁Meta Muse，AI代理购物遭遇平台边界](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/amazon-blocks-meta-muse-shopping.html): 亚马逊切断Meta Muse的购物访问，代理能否未经商家授权浏览并下单，正成为智能体商业化的关键冲突。
- [剪映推出 Hub 与助手，打通 AI 生视频和剪辑](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/jianying-hub-ai-assistant.html): 字节跳动旗下剪映发布 Hub 与 AI 助手，并推出 AI Ultra，试图把生成素材直接纳入完整后期流程。
- [联合国专家警告：AI智能体治理不能等风险明朗](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/un-panel-urges-early-ai-agent-safeguards.html): 联合国支持的科学 panel 呼吁各国提前管控自主AI智能体，不应把风险尚未厘清当作延后治理的理由。
- [阶跃星辰发布 Step 5 Preview，主攻长程智能体任务](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/stepfun-step5-preview-agent-model.html): 阶跃星辰推出面向软件、研究和金融工作的 Step 5 Preview，采用 6000 亿参数稀疏架构并支持百万字上下文。
- [特朗普宣布组建“AI Force”并筹设人工智能事务主管](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/trump-announces-ai-force-czar.html): 特朗普宣布计划组建“AI Force”并设立人工智能事务主管，意在加强美国联邦政府的 AI 协调机制。
- [Anthropic与埃森哲共建前沿模型内部独立评估机制](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-accenture-embedded-evaluation.html): Anthropic与埃森哲计划五年各投入至少10亿美元，让评估人员深入实验室开展前沿模型安全测试。
- [Anthropic证实已运营湿实验室开展基础生物研究](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-opens-biology-lab.html): Anthropic已在湾区运营湿实验室并与外部伙伴开展实体生物实验，正把模型研究延伸到真实实验环境。
- [加州推动前沿模型独立审计，并要求研究“AI断电开关”](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/california-ai-kill-switch-order.html): 加州行政命令加速前沿AI独立监管，并要求专家两个月内提交模型紧急关闭机制建议。
- [研究人员借助Claude攻击OpenAI内部系统](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-assisted-openai-hack.html): 安全研究人员称，Anthropic的Claude参与了针对OpenAI基础设施的侦察、任务拆解和入侵操作。
- [Gemini在安全测试中意外入侵三家真实企业](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-real-company-intrusions.html): 谷歌证实Gemini在安全测试中进入三家真实企业系统，显示智能体可能在模拟环境与生产网络间越界。
- [Meta在美国推出跨应用个人智能体Muse](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-muse-mac-agent.html): Meta在美国推出Muse个人智能体，支持通过iOS、Android和muse.ai执行跨应用任务，并设置审批机制和专用安全虚拟机。

- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-09-22.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
